workflow: Scripted Simjecture commissioning; not autonomous discovery or independent review

contract.inputs: arbitrary finite rational RHS, N interior unknowns
contract.output: all N exact solution values, explicitly materialized
contract.cost: unit-cost scalar arithmetic/casts, input reads, branch inspection, output writes
contract.precomputation: none; all per-instance work charged; no compressed or lazy output
contract.comparison: at most 17 times every correct trace when N>0

claims.claim: Exact discrete correctness and uniqueness for all finite rational RHS
Theta(N) work optimality in the stated scalar trace model
Floating-point accuracy and timing on the sampled smooth problems
Bit complexity, best hardware constant, Euler optimality, and general PDE convergence
